subject: Offer banding & geo anchor operational matrix (proposal and approval)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Offer banding + geo anchor matrix (draft for approval)

Team — attaching the operational matrix we discussed for H2 hiring. Highlights: the attachment contains a per-level US base band, recommended midpoints, and a geo-anchor uplift table for EU and APAC (expressed as percentage multipliers). Also included is a short Mercer summary of external benchmarks.

Why now: hiring velocity is increasing and we need a deterministic offer decision surface so recruiters and hiring managers can operate without repeated escalation. The matrix includes:
- Level buckets (IC1–IC7, Manager, Sr Manager, Director+)
- Market anchors (US default, EU index, APAC index)
- Offer ceiling = midpoint + 20% (for candidate premium/strong fit cases)
- Auto-approval rules: offers <= midpoint + 10% for IC1–IC5 are Recruiter-approved; >10% up to 20% require People Partner signoff; Director+ requires People Lead approval and Finance signoff.

Asks: please review and confirm by end of week. If approved, next steps are: push matrix to the compensation docs on Drive, update offer templates, and notify hiring managers with one-pager guidance.

Attachments: offer-band-matrix-v2.xlsx (primary), benchmarks-mercersummary.pdf (methodology), offer-template-geo-remarks.docx (wording changes).

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer banding + geo anchor matrix (draft for approval)

Thanks Tessa — this is a useful start. A couple quick items:
1) US Senior Software Engineer (IC5) midpoint looks ~7% under market for our competitor set in SF/NY. Can you confirm Mercer sample includes Bay Area small-mid startups? If not, recommend bumping IC5 midpoint +7% in US only and leaving ceiling the same.
2) Please add an explicit note on currency conversions for EU anchors (use monthly FX close on offer day, not average).

If Mercer confirms the sample, I'll approve.

On Tue, Jul 14, 2026 at 09:12 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — attaching the operational matrix we discussed for H2 hiring...

Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer banding + geo anchor matrix (draft for approval)

Laura — I pulled the Mercer appendix and pushed a small revision (see offer-band-matrix-v3.xlsx attached in Drive link). Quick notes:
- Mercer's sample skews toward mid-market firms; they under-index very early-stage startups that have atypical cash/eq mixes. The +7% you cited aligns with our own gethired-scan results in SF that include seed/series-A startups.
- Proposal: apply +7% uplift to IC5 midpoint only for the Bay Area subzone (SF + Marin + South Bay <-> city list in tab 'zones'). This keeps national consistency while allowing local market competitiveness.
- APAC uplift: Mercer recommends +12% vs our current APAC anchor for India tech hubs; I'm proposing +8% for India (talent supply reason) and +12% for Singapore/Hong Kong.
- Approval flow: keep the auto-approvals as Tessa suggested but add an explicit step: any offer that uses a discretionary uplift (Bay Area +7% or APAC adjustments) must be logged in the hires sheet and reviewed weekly by People Ops.

I've added a short rationale section in the matrix and a proposed recruiter checklist. If Laura signs off on the Bay Area uplift, I'm fine to move forward.

— Aditya
Senior Director, Talent Strategy
From: Mercer Compensation <compbench@mercer.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 10:00:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Offer banding + geo anchor matrix (draft for approval)

Tessa / Team — thanks for sharing the matrix. A couple clarifications on methodology:
- Our sample includes firms in the mid-market and larger startups but underrepresents early Seed-stage companies. Where you anticipate offers to candidates from first- or second-time founders, consider a candidate-level adjustment rather than shifting the midpoint across the board.
- For APAC we compute two indices: APAC-EM (India, Philippines) and APAC-HQ (SG, HK). Using APAC-HQ as representative for Singapore/Hong Kong will justify the +12% uplift; for India hubs our data supports +6–9% depending on role.

Attached: Mercer's short note (benchmarks-mercersummary.pdf) and a link to the raw index table: https://mercer.example.com/indexes/redwood-2026-h2

If you want, I can run a custom extract limited to Bay Area startups only (adds ~72 companies) — that will refine the SF uplift estimate. Let me know by Monday and we can turn it around next week.

— Claire Denis
Principal, Global Compensation Services
Mercer Compensation
compbench@mercer.com
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, compbench@mercer.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer banding & geo anchor operational matrix (final decision)

Team — thanks for the diligence and fast turns. Decision summary and next steps: 
1) Approve the matrix with the following caveats:
   - IC5 Bay Area midpoint = baseline midpoint +7% (Aditya's proposed zone implementation).
   - APAC uplift applied as Aditya recommended: India +8%, Singapore/HK +12%.
   - Recruiters may continue to use ceiling = midpoint +20% for exceptional candidates, but any discretionary uplift that exceeds midpoint +10% must be entered into the weekly Hires log and flagged for People Ops review.
2) Action items:
   - Tessa: publish offer-band-matrix-v3.xlsx to the People Drive and update the offer-template-geo-remarks.docx to include the new approval flow (due 2026-07-23).
   - Laura & Aditya: coordinate a 30-min sync with Finance to confirm headcount budget accounting for uplift adjustments (please include Finance Ops).
   - Mercer: please run the Bay Area startup extract Claire offered and share results; we'll use it as a sanity check for Q3.
3) Communication: I'll send a short note to hiring managers after Tessa publishes the live doc. We'll keep the policy effective immediately for new offers.

Good work — let's keep the decision surface tight and make sure recruiters have a clear checklist.

Michael Grant
Head of Talent, Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com
